::: {.why}
It is the field's standard correction, it is the right idea, and its assumptions are wrong in a way you are unusually well placed to notice.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- State what the deflated Sharpe ratio deflates by, naming all four inputs.
- Name the assumption it makes about the set of strategies tried that is usually false, and say which direction the failure biases the result.
